story: --> Welcome to Dutton Road Veterinary Clinic & Surgical Facility Dutton Road Veterinary Clinic is a full-service, state-of-the art veterinary clinic and surgical facility located in Northeast Philadelphia, PA. Our caring and knowledgable staff are committed to the health and well-being of your pet. We offer low-cost vaccines, spays and neuters, general and specialty surgeries and specialize in pet dentistry. Call To Make An Appointment Today! 215-331-2968 We are a non-profit organization and offer our services and surgical procedures at very affordable prices.
